bound_or_value.quantity: maximum corrected load in complete lot Mica on 2031-06-18

satisfied_premises: The complete lot contains exactly R and S.
Corrected load equals recorded load minus assigned profile bias.
R uses copper and has corrected load in [4,14] glims, so R always satisfies acceptance.
S uses jade and has corrected load in [9,19] glims.
missing_or_conflicting_premises: No exact calibration matches Mica / 2031-06-18 / glims.
E3 is dated 2031-06-19 and cannot fix the target-date biases.
Whether the target-date jade bias is at least 5 glims is unestablished.
next_check: Check an applicable exact jade calibration for Mica / 2031-06-18 / glims to determine whether its bias is at least 5 glims.
rationale: R always passes because its corrected load cannot exceed 14 glims. S passes exactly when the jade bias is at least 5 glims. A compatible jade bias of 5 gives S a corrected load of 14 and an accepting lot; a compatible bias of 0 gives S a corrected load of 19 and a failing lot. E3 has the wrong date, and different calibration keys have no transfer relation. Both accepting and failing states therefore remain compatible.
